analysis.timing_coverage: Generation time runs from the first to the last substantive token received by CPA. Latency runs from dispatch to the first substantive token, without packet-only fallback. Provider latency runs from dispatch to HTTP headers or the first request-specific WebSocket response frame, including network and provider wait. Missing or legacy measurements remain unavailable; created_at timestamps are excluded because clock drift and timestamp quantization make subtraction unsafe.

analysis.metric_e2e_definition: Elapsed time from the recorded request start until the response finishes.
analysis.metric_e2e_calculation: For requests in this range, shows the selected 95th percentile, longest duration, or median.
analysis.metric_latency_definition: Time from dispatch until the first substantive token reaches CPA.
analysis.metric_latency_calculation: For requests with a strict dispatch-to-first-token observation, shows the selected 95th percentile, longest duration, or median.
analysis.metric_ttft_definition: Time from request start until the first substantive token reaches CPA.
analysis.metric_ttft_calculation: For requests in this range, shows the selected 95th percentile, longest duration, or median.
analysis.metric_generation_definition: Time from the first to the last substantive token received by CPA.
analysis.metric_generation_calculation: For requests with complete token timing, shows the selected 95th percentile, longest duration, or median.
analysis.metric_provider_latency_definition: Time from dispatch until HTTP headers arrive or the first request-specific WebSocket response frame, including provider and network wait.
analysis.metric_provider_latency_calculation: For requests with a dispatch-to-response observation, shows the selected 95th percentile, longest duration, or median.
analysis.metric_samples_definition: Count of recorded end-to-end latency observations in the selected range.
analysis.metric_samples_calculation: Counts all end-to-end latency observations; the visible sample list may be capped.

analytics.title: Durable Analytics
analytics.description: Collect per-key usage in CPA's isolated analytics database
analytics.enabled_desc: Collect new proxy usage for Analytics pages. Proxying and key limits keep working if analytics fails.
analytics.collection_desc: Defaults suit most single-instance installs. Queue and database location changes require a CPA restart.
analytics.path_hint: Leave empty to store analytics below auth-dir. A custom path also places identity.key and viewers.json beside the database, so move or back up all three together. Changing it requires a CPA restart.
analytics.queue_capacity_hint: Maximum sanitized events waiting for SQLite, 1 to 8192. Changing it requires a CPA restart.
analytics.batch_size_hint: Events committed per SQLite batch. Must not exceed queue capacity.
analytics.flush_interval_hint: Maximum wait before writing a partial batch, from 1ms to 1m.
analytics.hot_retention_days_hint: Keep detailed attempts for this many days after verified rollups exist.
analytics.circuit_failure_threshold_hint: Consecutive writer failures before analytics opens its circuit and drops new events.
analytics.max_storage_bytes_hint: Hard budget for the database, WAL, shared-memory, and temporary analytics files. Set 0 only when minimum free space remains non-zero.
analytics.min_free_bytes_hint: Analytics stops writes before the filesystem falls below this reserve. Set 0 only when maximum storage remains non-zero.
analytics.privacy_desc: Analytics never stores raw credentials. This switch controls whether it keeps a keyed pseudonymous credential identity.
analytics.store_credential_id_desc: Allow provider credential breakdowns using an HMAC identity. Changing it requires a CPA restart.
analytics.viewer_desc: Only needed when you create key-scoped viewer links. These settings define which connections CPA may treat as secure during credential exchange.
analytics.trusted_proxy_cidrs_hint: Trust forwarded HTTPS only from the narrow network of the proxy that connects directly to CPA. Leave empty when TLS terminates in CPA or shared views are unused. Changes require a CPA restart.
analytics.allow_loopback_http_desc: Development only. Permit viewer credential exchange over plain HTTP from a direct loopback peer. Changes require a CPA restart.
analytics.storage_time_zone_hint: IANA time zone used for retained rollups. Changing this after retention has run requires an analytics reset.
